risk_note: RV2 by path (infra/** is outside the risk-map whitelist); a drill script, no money code. infra/drills/switches: per non-fund switch (payout.* / pay.* / withdraw.* refused before any read or write) read the value, write the degraded value with a fresh step-up token per write (adminStepUp, operator's authenticator code read without echo), observe the degradation within 10 s, restore with a fresh token, observe the baseline again (field-by-field equal to the recorded healthy baseline); restores on failure, SIGINT and SIGTERM. Targets: local and staging only (prod and unlisted hosts refused; staging allowlist is the reviewed staging-origins.json, empty for now). Observable switches use the convertLink probe (50301); agent.enabled, jev.enabled and parse.tpwd.enabled have no observation point in the contract or the non-production adapters and are refused as unobservable. Records hold problem codes only, never credentials. The Codex skeleton had been left out of the first spec commit by the lane's commit helper (it staged test/apps/packages only); it was recovered unchanged from the object store and amended into the spec commit, and the helper now stages infra too. Host: local tsconfig typecheck, eslint, prettier 0; Codex-written rule tests run only in the container (verify:fast was killed at tsc by memory, 137), so the rule tests are judged by the container red run and the required CI checks (approvals #21).
